summary: The Skin Lab has a 4.8 rating from 415 Google reviews, video testimonials and a licence number. The booking path is message only and a few details look unfinished.

findings.problem: Every main button points to #enquire, and the page describes a message only flow. No consultation fee or price is shown anywhere.
findings.cost: A patient who cannot book directly or see a price hesitates, and many will pick a clinic with instant booking.
findings.fix: Online booking with date and time, and starting prices for top treatments.

findings.problem: The FAQ says you are open including public holidays, then says you are closed on National Day and two Eid holidays. The footer hours read Monday to Sunday09:00 to 21:00.
findings.cost: Contradictory hours cause wasted visits and bad reviews.
findings.fix: One accurate set of hours shown the same everywhere.

findings.problem: The client avatars use demo file names (sl-demo) and appear to be placeholders. Review excerpts name Dr Ella, Dr. Ella and Ela.
findings.cost: Demo content next to real reviews makes visitors wonder which proof is real.
findings.fix: Only real, named patient proof, with consistent doctor names.

findings.problem: There are no before and after results and no Instagram or Facebook links. The footer WhatsApp icon is an empty link.
findings.cost: Aesthetic patients decide on visible results and on social proof they can check.
findings.fix: A captioned results gallery, working social links and a labelled WhatsApp button.

redesign: A booking first homepage with online scheduling, WhatsApp and starting prices.
Real proof beside every button: your 4.8 rating, named reviews and captioned results.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like Botox Abu Dhabi and laser hair removal Abu Dhabi.
